headline: Ukraine needs more than $52 billion in external financing for 2027: Koretskyi's statement in Bangkok
summary: Ukraine needs to attract more than $52 billion in external budget financing for 2027, said Koretskyi in Bangkok. The figure was given as a statement at the event.
why: Ukraine's budget relies on foreign official and multilateral financing, so the size of its funding gap affects sovereign debt risk and reconstruction planning.
